view_map.section: axis +Z runs left to right; datum A at z=0

features.rationale: Nominal finished annular spacer; section confirms an open concentric bore throughout the axial length.
Chamfer both bore mouths, as explicitly depicted in section; do not apply the typical callout to unrelated edges.
Centered end slot at twelve o'clock, through the radial wall and blind axially from datum A.
features.justification: The front view and upper local detail center the slot about the vertical centerline. The unhatched upper-left section establishes its .75 axial depth. The front slot lines run from the bore to the OD, establishing through-wall extent. The rectangular cutter begins within the bore and extends beyond the OD to avoid coincident cut boundaries.

features.rationale: What size and method of edge break are required for the remaining sharp outside and slot corners?
features.justification: Zero is only an unresolved size placeholder, not a specified edge-break size. The drawing supplies neither a size nor a chamfer-versus-radius requirement; listed outside edges are representative and the slot edges also require review.

notes: Full-sheet title identifies SPACER, drawing 4092-B, model 100TW; A040921E is retained as the supplied part identifier. Material: 1018.

This plan represents nominal finished geometry. The asterisk on 3.000 refers to '* ALLOW .060 STOCK FOR GR. AT ASSY'. Retain 0.060 inch axial grinding stock for the preassembly manufacturing stage; it is not added to the finished 3.000 model.
Datum A is the slotted end at z=0. Opposite end face parallelism to A is D008; this is a manufacturing control, not extra geometry.
Full-sheet title block explicitly specifies inches, third-angle projection, two-place tolerance ±.02, three-place tolerance ±.010, and angular tolerance ±1°. Bore tolerance is explicitly +.002/-.000.
D009 and D010 are derived extraction values rather than additional drawing requirements.
